name: generated-visual-discovery
goal: Emit stable discoverable visual case identities while retaining every generated state and viewport.

evidence: Generated initial pages and page, layout, component and partial state matrices use computed Playwright titles; Harness discovery reports them as unresolved dynamic cases.

The existing project-template and piece-generator cases check screenshot text and viewports but never require discovery to enumerate stable qualified case identities. Strengthen those cases without adding test titles.
